line: Bitcoin retreats while policymakers in Seoul, Washington and Ottawa draft rules for stablecoins and digital-asset taxation.

wire_top3.line: South Korea delays crypto gains tax to 2029, tying implementation to US integration of OECD's international digital-asset tax framework.
